styles.name: rose
styles.description: Rhodonea rose r=cos(k·θ): petals unfurl from the center as progress rises, the whole bloom slowly rotating with time

styles.name: spirograph
styles.description: Hypotrochoid spirograph: the inner-wheel trace of a circle rolling inside a larger circle, drawing an intricate looping flower as progress sweeps θ

styles.name: epitrochoid
styles.description: Epitrochoid: a small circle rolling *outside* a fixed circle traces a multi-lobed crown; progress reveals the full pattern chord by chord

styles.name: superformula
styles.description: Gielis superformula: one equation, many shapes — each panel morphs through a star, a rounded triangle, a six-petal flower, a pillowed square, a spiky burst, a thin seven-arm star and a lens; progress traces the outline, time morphs the parameters

styles.name: phyllotaxis
styles.description: Sunflower phyllotaxis: seeds appear at the golden angle 137.5°, radius ∝ √n, producing the mesmerising Fibonacci spiral pattern of real sunflowers and pinecones

styles.name: cardioid
styles.description: Cardioid: chords from point i to 2·i on a circle appear one by one while the heart-shaped envelope they converge on, (2e^{iθ}+e^{2iθ})/3, traces itself out as progress rises — a row of panels drawing in turn

styles.name: astroid
styles.description: Astroid (4-cusp hypocycloid): x=R·cos³θ, y=R·sin³θ — a star-shaped curve with four sharp cusps that sweeps closed as progress completes a full 2π revolution

styles.name: lemniscate
styles.description: Lemniscate of Bernoulli: the ∞ figure-eight (x²+y²)²=a²(x²−y²), traced with the rational parametric form — both lobes materialise symmetrically as progress sweeps 0→2π

styles.name: maurer-rose
styles.description: Maurer rose: points of the rose r=cos(5θ) at 71° steps joined by straight chords, the first 36 chords weaving a star web in each of a row of panels as progress rises

styles.name: mystic-rose
styles.description: Mystic rose: every pair of vertices of a regular pentagon joined by a chord — the pentagon and its inscribed pentagram, ten chords appearing one by one as progress rises, across a row of panels

styles.name: fermat-spiral
styles.description: Fermat's (parabolic) spiral r=±a√θ: both symmetric arms uncoil one and a half turns from the origin as progress sweeps outward, the pair slowly rotating with time, across a row of panels
